# SIGNARA

> Executive consultancy. The comfort layer between business and digital chaos.

Signara helps executive leadership navigate digital transformation with clarity, confidence, and intelligence. The full consultancy site is launching soon; Signara Pulse and Signara Academy are already live.

## About

- Website: https://thesignara.com
- Contact: alyona@alyonawhite.com
- Founder: Alyona White (https://alyonawhite.com)
- Status: Consultancy launching soon; Pulse and Academy live

## What Signara does

Signara is an executive consultancy specialising in digital transformation intelligence. We work with leadership teams to reduce complexity, sharpen decision-making, and bring order to the intersection of business strategy and technology.

## Signara Pulse

- [Signara Pulse](https://thesignara.com/pulse): daily executive intelligence brief for Tech, CPG, Pharma and Telco leaders across Central and Western Europe, refreshed every morning
- [Signara Pulse — Romania](https://thesignara.com/pulse/ro): a separate daily brief for executives operating in the Romanian market
- [Pulse archive](https://thesignara.com/pulse/archive): weekly editions of past briefs

## Signara Academy

- [Paid Ads, End to End](https://thesignara.com/academy/ads-start/): Google Search and Meta Ads for independent educators and tutors — one method, four steps, campaigns live by the end
- [Step 1: Set up the accounts](https://thesignara.com/academy/ads-start/01-setup-accounts.html)
- [Step 2: Create and connect the machinery](https://thesignara.com/academy/ads-start/02-connect-tech.html)
- [Step 3: Prepare and input campaigns](https://thesignara.com/academy/ads-start/03-campaign-settings.html)
